svg.title: One frozen Runtime Pack release, several independently pinned projects
svg.desc: Runtime Pack 2.5.0 is qualified and was frozen by a person's decision; it never changes, and a fix is a new release. Project A and Project B each pin Runtime Pack 2.5.0 by its exact identity (root path, version, revision and tree digest), check that pin with the release's own pin tool, and keep their own records: scope, progress, findings and decisions. Their runs never change the pack. Runtime Pack 2.6.0 is in development and not qualified; a pin to it is refused because it is not frozen.
